previous_statement: Assembly. Under the hypotheses of node 1, use the universal L,e_env of node 1.1. Node 1.2 proves the asserted c_0^cb*epsilon-projection statement for every nonempty U and supplies the nonvanishing hypothesis; node 1.3 then proves the extended L*epsilon-C*-algebra statement for every A_U=S^A_{P_U}; node 1.4 proves every stated subordination and complementarity estimate for every U subseteq R. These statements are exactly all clauses of the root contract, using only the registered definitions, lem-maincb-error-improvement for its universal c_0^cb witness, and lem-compcb-corner-algebra for the compressed-corner conclusion.
new_statement: Assembly after the explicit same-(A,w) notation bridge in node 1.5.1. In the root conclusion P_U and A_U are the local abbreviations P_U:=w(e_U) and A_U:=S^A_{P_U} for e_U=sum_{j in U}e_j; they are not taken from an independently supplied MAIN-CB partition state. Under the hypotheses of node 1, use the universal L,e_env of node 1.1. With this binding, node 1.2 proves the asserted c_0^cb*epsilon-projection and nonvanishing statements for every nonempty U, node 1.3 proves the extended L*epsilon-C*-algebra statement for every A_U, and node 1.4 proves every subordination and complementarity estimate for U subseteq R. Thus nodes 1.1-1.4 together with the context repair 1.5.1 establish exactly all clauses of the root contract without an additional state hypothesis.
